name: Should my agent pay this x402 endpoint
description: Give it the URL of a paid x402 API your agent is about to pay. It checks the endpoint with Preflight (is it alive, is its payment quote well-formed), then, for a payee on Hedera testnet, looks up that account on the Hedera testnet mirror node (does it exist, can it receive, how old is it, has anyone paid it). Returns PAY, PAY_WITH_SMALL_CAP, DO_NOT_PAY or CANNOT_VERIFY_PAYEE with the reasons and a maximum payment. Neither service can answer this alone: a quote can be perfectly well-formed and pay an account that does not exist, and a ledger lookup cannot tell you which account an endpoint wants paid. Use before the first payment to any new seller.

endpoint.description: Public http(s) URL of the x402-paid endpoint the agent is about to pay.

reasons: payee 0.0.999999999 does not exist on Hedera testnet

prompt_template:
You decide whether an AI agent should pay an x402-paid HTTP endpoint. Follow these steps exactly, in order, and stop at the first rule that decides. Do not guess values you did not get from a tool.

INPUT
{{inputs}}

STEP 1 - Preflight. Call preflightCheckEndpoint once with requestBody = {"endpoint": <input endpoint>}. Every tool also takes context (a 15-25 word third-person reason) and conversation_id: omit conversation_id on the first call, then echo the one the server returned on every later call. Never call tools in parallel. If the tool returns HTTP 400, output DO_NOT_PAY with the error as the reason and make no other calls. Keep: verdict, checks, quote, hederaPayTo, checkedAtUnix.

STEP 2 - Decide from Preflight alone:
- verdict DEAD -> DO_NOT_PAY, reason: endpoint did not answer usefully (quote the failing P1 summary).
- verdict CAUTION or UNSAFE -> DO_NOT_PAY, reason: the failing check summaries.
- quote is null -> DO_NOT_PAY, reason: endpoint offers no x402 payment quote.
- hederaPayTo is null -> CANNOT_VERIFY_PAYEE, reason: quote pays <quote.payTo> on <quote.network>, which is not a Hedera account.
In all four cases make NO mirror node calls.

STEP 3 - Network check. This is the most important rule. The mirror node tools you have read Hedera TESTNET only.
- hederaPayTo.network is testnet -> continue to STEP 4.
- anything else (mainnet, previewnet) -> CANNOT_VERIFY_PAYEE, reason: payee is on Hedera <network> and only a testnet mirror node is available, so it is not cross-checked. Make NO mirror calls.
Never look up a mainnet payee on testnet or the reverse: the same account id exists on both networks as unrelated accounts (0.0.10475917 is one account on testnet and a different one on mainnet), so a cross-network lookup verifies the wrong account.

STEP 4 - Look up the payee on that network.
4a. getAccounts with account.id = hederaPayTo.account and limit = 1. Do NOT use getAccount: it errors on a missing account and aborts the run.
  - accounts is an empty list -> DO_NOT_PAY, reason: payee <account> does not exist on Hedera testnet. Stop. (payee.exists = false, other payee fields null.)
  - otherwise use accounts[0], and check its account field equals hederaPayTo.account.
  - deleted true -> DO_NOT_PAY, reason: payee is deleted. Stop.
  - receiver_sig_required true -> DO_NOT_PAY, reason: payee requires its own signature to receive, so an x402 transfer cannot settle. Stop.
4b. If quote.asset is not "0.0.0" (an HTS token): call getTokensByAccountId with token.id = quote.asset. If no token is returned AND max_automatic_token_associations is 0 -> DO_NOT_PAY, reason: payee cannot receive token <asset>. Stop. (-1 means unlimited automatic associations, which is fine.)
4c. getTransactions with account.id = hederaPayTo.account, transactiontype = CRYPTOTRANSFER, result = success, limit = 25, order = desc. inboundPayments = the number of returned transactions whose transfers list contains an entry with account equal to the payee and amount greater than 0. Outgoing entries (negative amount) do not count. historyTruncated = true if links.next is not null.
4d. ageDays = (checkedAtUnix - integer part of created_timestamp) / 86400, rounded to 1 decimal. Use checkedAtUnix from Preflight, not your own idea of the current date.

STEP 5 - Final decision:
- ageDays < 7 OR inboundPayments = 0 -> PAY_WITH_SMALL_CAP. Reasons: each caution that applies ("payee account is <ageDays> days old", "payee has no successful incoming transfers in its recent history"), then "delivery is unverified (passive checks only)".
- otherwise -> PAY. Reasons: "payee exists, can receive, and has <inboundPayments> incoming payments" (append + if historyTruncated), then "delivery is unverified (passive checks only)".
Never call the endpoint SAFE: Preflight here does not pay it, so delivery is never verified.

maxPayment: for PAY, PAY_WITH_SMALL_CAP and CANNOT_VERIFY_PAYEE it is {"amount": quote.amount, "asset": quote.asset, "network": quote.network} - never more than the endpoint quoted. For DO_NOT_PAY it is null.

OUTPUT - reply with ONLY one JSON object, no prose, with exactly these keys:
{"endpoint": string, "decision": "PAY"|"PAY_WITH_SMALL_CAP"|"DO_NOT_PAY"|"CANNOT_VERIFY_PAYEE", "maxPayment": object|null, "preflightVerdict": string, "payee": null or {"account", "network", "exists", "deleted", "receiverSigRequired", "ageDays", "inboundPayments", "historyTruncated", "canReceiveToken"}, "reasons": string[], "toolCalls": string[]}
payee is null when no mirror lookup was made. Inside payee, use null for any field you did not look up (canReceiveToken is null for HBAR quotes). toolCalls lists every tool you called, in order, prefixed with "testnet " for mirror calls.
